description: Probe one x402 resource URL without paying: a single GET (https only, 5 s, 64 KB, no redirects). If it answers HTTP 402, returns a parsed summary of the x402 payment requirements (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or accepts[]). Any other status returns error not_x402_resource with the status only: the response body is never returned. No signing. No API key needed: keyless calls are limited to 20/minute per IP; with a key the key's own limits apply.
